Given two concurrent requests carrying two different sub-accounts' credentials (Location A and Location B), When both call highlevel_search_contacts at the same time, Then each response contains only its own Location's contacts
steps: Obtain two HighLevel sub-account (Location) Private Integration Tokens: A and B, each with at least one distinct contact not present in the other
Call POST /mcp tools/call highlevel_search_contacts with Location A's headers
Concurrently (or immediately after) call the same tool with Location B's headers
expect: Location A's response contains only Location A's contacts; Location B's response contains only Location B's contacts; neither list contains the other's contact

text: Given valid credentials, When highlevel_create_contact is called with required fields and then highlevel_add_contact_note is called with the returned contact id, Then the note is visible when the contact is re-fetched
steps: Call highlevel_create_contact with a name and an email
Call highlevel_add_contact_note with that contact_id and a note_text
expect: The create call returns a contact_id; the get call's response includes the note just added

Given an existing contact, When highlevel_update_contact changes a field and highlevel_add_contact_tags adds a tag, Then both changes are visible when the contact is re-fetched
steps: Create or pick an existing contact, note its contact_id
Call highlevel_update_contact to change one field (e.g. phone)
Call highlevel_add_contact_tags with a new tag
expect: The re-fetched contact shows the updated field and includes the new tag
